title: Wicked

scenesThatPass:
VARIOUS OZIANS: It's her!/It's Glinda!/The Witch of the North!/It's Glinda the Good!
GLINDA: It's good to see me, isn't it? No need to respond-- that was rhetorical. Fellow Ozians...

MRS. THROPP: What is it, what's wrong?
DULCIBEAR: HOW CAN IT BE?

GALINDA: Remember, it's not goodbye, it's farewell.
GALINDA: Now it's goodbye.
GALINDA'S PARENTS: Goodbye, precious!/We love you!
GALINDA: They're going to miss me so much.

SHENSHEN: Do you remember us?
GALINDA: Of course!
STUDENT CHOIR: O HALLOWED HALLS AND VINE-DRAPED WALLS...
STUDENT CHOIR: THE PROUDLIEST SIGHT TH ERE IS

GALINDA: Well, I for one am so sorry that you're forced to live with-- This--
ELPHABA: Is that so?
GALINDA: Yes, and it's my intention to major in sorcery, so-- if at some future time you wanted to-- address the problem? Perhaps I could-- help.
ELPHABA: Offering to help someone you don't know with a skill you don't have. I'm sure everyone's duly impressed.

speakers.name: IN THE BACK OF THE QUAD

plot: Elphaba, a young woman with green skin, navigates life at Shiz University and forms an unlikely friendship with the popular Galinda. Their bond deepens as they encounter the Wizard of Oz, leading to a series of events that ultimately shape their destinies and transform them into the Wicked Witch of the West and Glinda the Good.
